blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, QUEZON, Philippines — The municipal government of San Juan, Batangas, has conducted basic Filipino Sign Language (FSL) training for its employees to promote more inclusive and accessible public services. Municipal personnel from various departments took part in the three-day training held on Nov. 10 to 12, where they learned basic sign language skills to improve their communication with deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals. “The program aims to equip municipal personnel with the skills needed to provide more inclusive, efficient, and equitable public services, particularly to individuals who use Filipino Sign Language as their primary means of communication,” the local government’s […]...
